Engineering Public Hearing Results, March 20, 2020

The Sustainable Streets Division of the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency held a public hearing to receive comments on the following proposed changes.

  • 1. ESTABLISH – BAY WHEELS BIKE SHARE STATION – Ellis Street, north side, from 8 feet to 59 feet east of Raymond Kimball Park. A Bay Wheels bike share station is proposed in the parking lane on the north side of Ellis Street, adjacent to Raymond Kimball Park. No comments were received.

    APPROVED by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.

  • 2. ESTABLISH – BAY WHEELS BIKE SHARE STATION – Arlington Street, south side, adjacent to the green space owned by the City and County of San Francisco. Comments were received in support and opposition.

    CONTINUED TO APRIL 3, 2020

  • 3. RESCIND – BIKE SHARE STATION – Hyde Street, west side. Relocation of a bikeshare station to accommodate a Shared Space request. No comments were received.

    WITHDRAWN

  • 4. ESTABLISH – SPEED HUMP – Anza Street between 2nd Avenue and 3rd Avenue. No comments were received.

    APPROVED
